At PwC, our people in data and analytics focus on leveraging data to drive insights and make informed business decisions. They utilise advanced analytics techniques to help clients optimise their operations and achieve their strategic goals.
In business intelligence at PwC, you will focus on leveraging data and analytics to provide strategic insights and drive informed decision-making for clients. You will develop and implement innovative solutions to optimise business performance and enhance competitive advantage.
Job Profile - Description
Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member’s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system. 
Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. 
Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables. 
Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same. 
Effectively mentor others. 
Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members. 
Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate. 
Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements. 
 The Opportunity
Join PwC as a Manager in Business Intelligence, where you will leverage data and analytics to provide strategic insights and drive informed decision-making for our clients. You will be at the forefront of developing and implementing innovative solutions to optimise business performance and enhance competitive advantage. As part of our data and analytics team, you will play a crucial role in helping clients achieve their strategic goals. Your leadership will be instrumental in motivating and inspiring others to deliver quality, while embracing technology and innovation to enhance delivery.
Your Responsibilities
 Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the components of entire systems
 Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion
 Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables
 Develop skills outside your comfort zone and encourage others to do the same
 Effectively mentor and leverage team members’ unique strengths
 Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members
 Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members, and stakeholders, escalating where appropriate
 Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards, the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements
 What You Bring
 High school diploma
 4+ years of experience in data and analytics or a related field
 Ability to analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system
 Proven experience in project ownership, ensuring successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion
 Strong capability to partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables
 What Sets You Apart
 Proficiency with Power BI
 Experience in AI-human collaboration and AI fluency
 Skills in strategic questioning and analytical thinking
 Ability to embrace change and demonstrate emotional regulation
 Strong relationship-building skills
 Additional Information
Join PwC's Business Intelligence team and help drive strategic insights and informed decision-making for our clients.
